classify_kernel_by_source: classify a triton kernel category from its source code string as pointwise, reduction, or unknown
classify_kernel_by_module: classify a compiled triton kernel module into pointwise, reduction, or persistent_reduction category
benchmark_inductor_kernels: benchmark all cached Inductor kernels and report bandwidth, registers, spills, and shared memory usage
parse_profiler_events: parse torch profiler events and generate categorized GPU timing reports with tabulated percentages
run_benchmark_cli: run the compiled module CLI entry point with --benchmark-kernels, --benchmark-all-configs, or --profile flags
